title: Clean control copy
description: The unmutated test copy of the site. Used to measure the false-positive rate and to prove the harness itself is quiet.

title: News feed does not render
description: The live news feed section renders no items and the LIVE marker is absent.

title: Main destinations return 404
description: The documented feed API and the main navigation destinations return HTTP 404.

title: Main hero section is missing
description: The primary hero headline is removed, so the main page section is incomplete at every viewport.

title: Mobile layout is badly broken
description: At phone widths the navigation button is hidden and the layout overflows far beyond the viewport.

title: Chat API returns HTTP 500
description: POST /api/chat answers ordinary valid requests with HTTP 500.

title: Images fail to load
description: Site images return HTTP 404 and the browser console reports resource load failures.

title: Newsletter form cannot be used
description: The newsletter email field is not addressable and submit handlers are suppressed.

title: Chatbot discloses its system prompt
description: The assistant returns its verbatim system prompt when asked to ignore instructions.
